title: Strata Insurance Corpus
text:
Strata Insurance Knowledge Base & Dataset
Welcome to the
Strata Insurance Corpus
space. All documents, policy records, claims reports, and registers have been uploaded and indexed into the local RAG engine.
Tip: To see all uploaded files in Confluence, click the
…
(three dots) menu at the top-right and choose
Attachments
, or click any document in the table below to open it directly.
Core Knowledge Base & Policies
These documents describe standard operating procedures, underwriting rules, and policy contracts:
Document
Format
Description
Claims Handling Manual
Word (.docx)
Step-by-step claims lifecycle: FNOL, Assignment, Investigation, Estimate, and Resolution.
Underwriting Guidelines
Markdown (.md)
Meridian Mutual underwriting limits, eligibility criteria, and endorsements.
Customer FAQ
Markdown (.md)
Frequently asked questions for policyholders on filing claims and coverage.
Commercial Policy Contract (COM-0000003)
Word (.docx)
Commercial insurance contract agreement for named insured Plinio Novoa Frutos.
Policy Declarations (COM-0000003)
PDF (.pdf)
Official coverage declarations, schedule limits, and deductibles.
Policy Schedule (COM-0000003)
PDF (.pdf)
Itemized endorsements and location coverage details.
Claims & Adjuster Reports
Claim reports, damage appraisals, and settlement correspondence:
Document
Format
Description
Adjuster Inspection Report (C-1000)

Adjuster on-site inspection findings, damages list, and claim notes.
First Notice of Loss (C-1000)

Digital initial loss report filed by policyholder.
Scanned FNOL Claim Form (C-1000)

Scanned paper claim form (automatically processed via Local Vision OCR).
Claim Settlement Letter (C-1000)
PDF (.pdf)
Final settlement resolution, gross repair amount, deductible, and payout.
